name: com.juahn.v2.vcontainer
author: armadimon
description: Bridge/adapter between hadashiA's VContainer DI and JuahnFrameworkV2's IServiceLocator abstraction. Lets a project standardized on VContainer expose the framework's IServiceLocator (backed by a VContainer IObjectResolver) and register IServiceInstaller bindings into a LifetimeScope. VContainer must be installed by the consumer.
